# Dangling <docs> targets that .github/scripts/Test-DocsTagTarget.ps1 tolerates.
#
# Format: target | reason
#   target  the tag's text, trimmed, exactly as written (path, or path#anchor)
#   reason  what is missing on the docs repository's develop branch
#
# Each entry is a target that named no docs-site page, or no heading on its page, when the guard was
# added (#2495). Fix one by writing the page or heading on the docs site, or by pointing every tag that
# names it at a page that exists, then delete the entry: the guard fails on an entry whose target now
# resolves or that no tag names any more, so this list only shrinks. Never add an entry to get a change
# through.
